questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of using graphs in economic analysis?

options.text: To visually represent data for easier understanding.
To increase the length of reports.

questions.explanation: Graphs are used to visually represent data, making it easier to understand and interpret trends and patterns. This is crucial in economic analysis where data can be complex.

distractorRationale.a: Graphs simplify data, not complicate it.
distractorRationale.c: Graphs aim to clarify, not obscure information.
distractorRationale.d: Graphs are used for clarity, not to lengthen reports.

questions.stem: If the data set is 5, 8, 12, 20, 25, what is the median?
questions.explanation: The median is the middle value in a data set ordered from least to greatest. Here, 12 is the middle number.

distractorRationale.b: 20 is the largest number, not the median.
distractorRationale.c: 8 is the second number in the ordered set.
distractorRationale.d: 5 is the smallest number in the set.

distractorRationale.b: 3 appears only once, so it is not the mode.
distractorRationale.c: 5 appears only once, so it is not the mode.

questions.stem: If a data set consists of the numbers 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12, what is the mean?
questions.explanation: To find the mean, add all the numbers (4 + 6 + 8 + 10 + 12 = 40) and then divide by the number of values (5). The mean is 40 / 5 = 8.

distractorRationale.a: 6 is not the correct average of the given data set.
distractorRationale.c: 10 is not the correct average of the given data set.
distractorRationale.d: 8.5 is not the correct average of the given data set.

questions.stem: Which measure of central tendency is most affected by extreme values?
questions.explanation: The mean is most affected by extreme values because it takes into account all values in the data set. If there are outliers, they can significantly skew the mean.

distractorRationale.b: The median is less affected by extreme values as it is the middle value.
distractorRationale.c: The mode is the most frequently occurring value and is not influenced by extreme values.
distractorRationale.d: This option is incorrect as the mean is indeed affected by extreme values.

questions.stem: In a data set of 15, 20, 20, 25, 30, what is the range?
questions.explanation: The range is calculated by subtracting the smallest value from the largest value in the data set. Here, 30 - 15 = 15.

distractorRationale.a: 10 is not the correct range of the data set.
distractorRationale.c: 20 is not the correct range of the data set.
distractorRationale.d: 25 is not the correct range of the data set.
